lines.t: (Intro – clean electric guitar, building drums)
Light breaks through the darkest night,
A voice like thunder splits the sky.
The Savior stands in holy flame,
The nations tremble at His name.
(Verse 1)
He walks among the golden lamps,
The Shepherd calling all His lambs.
His Word is sharp, a two-edged sword,
The truth unleashed, the risen Lord.
His footsteps shake the hills and plains,
He wipes all tears, removes all stains.
The Lion speaks, the mountains bow,
His kingdom rising even now.
YahuShua,
Fire in His eyes, truth in His voice.
He calls His people to arise,
To walk the path of His choice.
YahuShua,
Strength of the humble, breaking the chains.
The Light eternal still remains,
Forever He reigns, forever He reigns.
(Verse 2)
He gathers all from distant lands,
The faithful held within His hands.
The broken healed, the weary stand,
Restored by His redeeming plan.
The trumpet sounds across the sky,
The Bride made ready, purified.
The King returns in brilliant light,
The darkness shatters at His sight.
(Chorus – stronger, fuller)
YahuShua,
Fire in His eyes, truth in His voice.
He calls His people to arise,
To walk the path of His choice.
YahuShua,
Strength of the humble, breaking the chains.
The Light eternal still remains,
Forever He reigns, forever He reigns.
The stones cry out, creation sings,
The power of the King of kings.
His mercy falls like healing rain,
His justice stands, His truth proclaimed.
(guitar swell)
Holy… Holy…
YahuShua… (echo: YahuShua…)
You are the flame…
You are the flame…
YahuShua,
Fire in His eyes, truth in His voice.
He calls His people to arise,
To walk the path of His choice.
YahuShua,
Strength of the humble, breaking the chains.
The Light eternal still remains,
Forever He reigns… forever He reigns.
(Outro – guitars ringing out)
And when He comes in glorious sight,
The night will kneel before His light.
All hearts restored, all things made new,
Forever standing, Lord, with You.
